items.stem: Which word should be inserted in the blank so that the following statement is ALWAYS true? ''The ____________ of two numbers is 0 if any one of the numbers is 0.''
Which of the following CANNOT be positive?

options.label: A
options.text: The product of two negative numbers

options.label: B
options.text: The sum of two negative numbers

options.label: C
options.text: The difference of two negative numbers

options.label: D
options.text: The sum of a positive number and a negative number

items.answer: B. The sum of two negative numbers
